title: Capacity Planning: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Every year, more cars use the road. A sensible council adds lanes before it jams. That's capacity planning.

scenes.heading: The highway system
scenes.narration: Capacity planning follows a simple loop. Measure how busy your links are today. Set limits, seventy percent as a warning and ninety as critical. Forecast how much growth is coming. Upgrade before the link saturates.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three tips. Plan ahead of saturation. Look at the trend as well. Use NetFlow to see who's talking.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva capacity planning lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Measure, set thresholds, forecast, upgrade. Seventy is a warning, and ninety is critical. Use S N M P for history, and NetFlow for who. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva capacity planning lab.
